# Mathlib typo tickets

_Generated by `scripts/typo_audit/tickets.py` on 2026-09-29 from [`typos.md`](typos.md); 7303 open findings in 453 tickets._

**Each ticket is one pull request.** Work a ticket by opening `typos.md`, making the
edits its rows describe, and marking those rows `fixed`; the row disappears from both
documents on the next run.

## Sizing

At most **10 files** per ticket — a reviewer forms a separate judgement about each file.
A ticket applying a **single mechanical substitution** may span up to **300 files**,
because reading that whole diff is reading one decision; the `Kind` column says which
rule a ticket is under. Tickets are packed in path order, so one ticket stays inside one
area of the library.

Two kinds of ticket cost more than the files they list. A **declaration rename** moves
every call site: keep the old name with `@[deprecated (since := "…")] alias old := new`
for a theorem, or `@[deprecated new (since := "…")] abbrev old := new` for a `def`, so the
pull request stays in the declaring file; a named instance instead loses its name, with no
alias. Treat `Sweep` as the size of the follow-up. A
**file rename** (`PATH-*`) moves every `import` of it and the entry in `Mathlib.lean`,
and those must all be in the same pull request, because a dangling import does not
compile — for those, `Sweep` is part of the ticket, not a follow-up.

## Tiers

- **T1 — Ready to write.** Findings already marked `confirmed` in `typos.md`: someone has checked them by hand. Start here.  
  21 tickets, 160 findings, 142 files.
- **T2 — Mechanical, needs a skim.** Untriaged findings in categories where every row is the same substitution. A ticket is one decision plus a read-through.  
  119 tickets, 2036 findings, 1596 files.
- **T3 — Needs triage first.** Untriaged findings needing a judgement at every site. Triage them in `typos.md` before opening a pull request; they graduate to T1 as you do.  
  313 tickets, 5107 findings, 2397 files.
